$comment: Default OpenRouter model per pipeline stage. The owner can change any stage in Settings; choices are saved per workspace, profile and book. Every slug must be verified against GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models before phase 2 (verifyBeforePhase2). Never switch to a fallback silently: retry, then offer the next fallback to the owner.

verification.method: GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (public, no key) and match each slug's id, supported_parameters and architecture.output_modalities.
verification.lastResult: On 2026-10-04 every defaultModel and fallback slug below appeared in the public model list. Aliases starting with '~' point at the provider's latest model and can move without notice, so phase 2 must re-check them and record the concrete model each alias resolved to in the usage log.
stillToVerify: Whether the ':online' suffix works on '~' alias slugs (the docs example uses a concrete slug). Volume uses the web plugin object instead, which does not depend on the slug.
Header names for app attribution (HTTP-Referer and X-OpenRouter-Title per the plan; older docs used X-Title).
resolved: 2026-10-05: Claude Opus 5.5 rejects any non-default temperature, top_p or top_k with a 400, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 rejects non-default values (Anthropic migration guide for Opus 5.5 and the Claude API skill model table). OpenRouter still lists 'temperature' in supported_parameters for both, so modelRules below leave it out.

2026-10-05: reasoning tokens count against max_tokens on most providers; a cut-off answer comes back with finish_reason 'length' (OpenRouter reasoning-tokens guide). Stage max tokens were raised so reasoning models have room.

2026-10-07: OpenRouter reasoning-tokens guide (https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/best-practices/reasoning-tokens, read 2026-10-07): reasoning tokens count against max_tokens, a budget used up during reasoning returns finish_reason 'length' with empty content and the reasoning is still billed; effort 'low' is about 20% of max_tokens only where the model honours it. The free Nvidia summary models used 76% (6,078 of 8,000) on the retry, so summarise max tokens were raised from 4,000 to 16,000.

modelRules.note: The aliases point at Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Fable 5.1 today, which reject non-default sampling settings.
Claude Opus 4.7 and later, Sonnet 5 and later, Fable and Mythos return 400 for non-default temperature, top_p or top_k (Anthropic migration guides).

tiers.top: Best writing and planning model. Used where one call shapes the whole book.
tiers.mid: Strong, cheaper writer. Used for long text and edits.
tiers.small: Small fast model for checks, summaries and structured extraction.
tiers.search: Model run with OpenRouter web search. Sources come only from url_citation annotations.
tiers.image: Image model through the images endpoint. Never asked to draw text.

webSearch.alternative: Append ':online' to a concrete model slug.
webSearch.rule: Store only sources that arrive as url_citation annotations. Discard any URL or title the model types in its text.
webSearch.pricingNote: Native search is billed at the provider's price (pricing.web_search per request, several queries possible). Exa is USD 0.007 per request with up to 10 results (openrouter.ai/docs/guides/features/plugins/web-search, read 2026-10-05). On 2026-10-05 a live research call on Gemini 3.1 Pro with native search came back with no url_citation sources and no search charge, so a search call with no sources is tried once more with Exa.

imageDefaults.note: Title, subtitle and author name are always set by the app over the art, never generated by the model. One image per concept (n 1): only the first image of a request is used, so more would be paid for and thrown away. 2:3 art is fitted to the 1600 x 2560 eBook cover by the export.

budgets.note: Placeholder figures, not measured costs: the owner sets the real caps in Settings after the first budgeted live run. The job queue stops a book when the cap is reached and asks the owner. Estimates: the high end assumes the full output allowance (max tokens, or highOutputTokens where reasoning has been seen to go past it) plus highSearchesPerCall web searches for search stages.

research.notes: Run with the web plugin (webSearch.plugin) so every model in the list gets search. Native search for Google and Anthropic. Only url_citation sources are kept. To verify against GET /api/v1/models. Max tokens 16,000 and highOutputTokens 20,000: on 2026-10-05 Gemini 3.1 Pro used 11,951 output tokens (mostly reasoning) on one research call.

titles.notes: High temperature for variety; the app checks every title against listing.titleSubtitle.maxChars and the house style. To verify against GET /api/v1/models. Max tokens 16,000: Claude Sonnet 5.5 always reasons, and at 4,000 the title options were cut off (2026-10-05). Topic directions used about 3,300 output tokens.

blueprint.notes: One call shapes the whole book, so it gets the top tier. Structured output (supported_parameters includes structured_outputs on 2026-10-04). To verify against GET /api/v1/models. Max tokens 32,000: Claude Opus 5.5 always thinks and max tokens covers thinking plus text (Anthropic Opus 5.5 migration guide).

writing.notes: Streamed, one job per chapter. 12,000 tokens covers a 4,000-word chapter with room to spare. To verify against GET /api/v1/models. Max tokens 32,000 so reasoning cannot crowd out a 4,000-word chapter (streamed, so no request timeout).

summarise.notes: Runs after each chapter: summary for later chapters plus the used-already ledger. To verify against GET /api/v1/models. Max tokens 16,000 (was 4,000): reasoning counts against max tokens, and in the free live run of 2026-10-06 the summary was cut off even after the retry at 8,000 (6,078 reasoning tokens), which stopped the writing run. A cut-off answer is retried once at twice the room (32,000). The answer itself is capped by checks.summarise-and-ledger v4.

checks.notes: Code checks run first (em dashes, spellings, banned phrases, word counts, guardrailPatterns); the model only does claims and consistency. ~openai/gpt-mini-latest did not list 'temperature' in supported_parameters on 2026-10-04, so the client must drop it for that fallback. To verify against GET /api/v1/models. Max tokens 16,000 (was 8,000): in the free live run of 2026-10-07 (nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free) the chapter 2 checks answer was cut off even after the retry with more room (9,652 reasoning tokens of 16,000), which then lost the chapter; the server now saves the text and flags checks_missing instead. A cut-off answer is retried once at twice the room (32,000). No expectedOutputTokens on purpose: the server estimates checks with an expected word count (600 words per call), and setting expectedOutputTokens would drop the reasoning allowance from that estimate, so leaving it unset keeps the estimate as it was (checked 2026-10-07).

editing.notes: Every accepted edit becomes a new version. To verify against GET /api/v1/models. Max tokens 32,000: a line edit returns the whole chapter plus reasoning.

matter_metadata.notes: Character limits come from config/kdp-rules and are checked by code after the call. To verify against GET /api/v1/models.

cover_brief.notes: Writes the brief and 3 to 4 concept prompts. To verify against GET /api/v1/models.

cover_image.receives: imagePrompt from cover.cover-image, a scene prompt from children.scene-prompts, or a reference prompt from children.character-reference
cover_image.pictureBookNotes: D-045: a spread image is one 2:1 picture split across the gutter of two facing pages. Each main character gets one 2:3 full-body reference image first; it is sent as input_references on every spread, and a fixed seed is sent when the model lists seed in supported_parameters (https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/multimodal/image-generation, read 2026-10-17). 2:1 and 2:3 are on the list the endpoint accepted on 2026-10-05. Whether google/gemini-2.5-flash-image lists seed is still to verify against GET /api/v1/models before phase 7 starts.
cover_image.notes: Uses POST /api/v1/images (base64 results, no charge on failure per the plan). One image per concept (n 1). Aspect ratio 2:3 (5:8 is rejected); the export fits it to 1600 x 2560. The model never draws text; typography is added by the app. Export converts to JPEG for KDP (ebook.cover file types). To verify against GET /api/v1/models.

marketing.notes: To verify against GET /api/v1/models. Max tokens 16,000: a launch pack used about 4,900 output tokens on Claude Sonnet 5.5 (2026-10-05).
